context: Title 'PEACOCK'. Range (0 TO 360, steps=20) feeds Rotate on XZ Plane. Second Range feeds Graph Mapper (curve, domain -0.75 TO 0.75) modulating radius. List Length, Division /2, Random (seed=123), Cull Index removes random panels. Custom Preview WHITE for panels, GRAY and RED via List Item for selected elements.
